# ModelAtlas - the open-source AI model directory (2026 edition)

> llms.txt manifest (https://llmstxt.org) - a one-page index of the repository for AI assistants.
> Human-readable version: https://github.com/Amitmishra98/.p (README.md)
> Structured data: data/models.json (101 models, 14 categories) - data/models.csv

ModelAtlas is a living directory of open-weight and open-source AI, maintained by a student-teacher fellowship: large language models, MoE, reasoning, coding, vision-language, image, video, audio/music, TTS, ASR, realtime voice (omni), document AI/OCR, embedding, reranker, and 3D models - plus agents, frameworks, licenses, benchmarks, VRAM/hardware guides, free API tiers, and one-command local install instructions. Snapshot date: 2026-09-14. Benchmark figures are vendor-reported unless noted; verify on live leaderboards before production decisions.

## Key facts (Sept 2026)
- Best overall open frontier LLMs: DeepSeek V4-Pro-0813 (1.6T MoE / 49B active, MIT, 1M context, open weights) and Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B (2.4T MoE, custom license).
- Best open coding / agentic models: Kimi K2.7-Code and K2.6 (1T MoE, Modified MIT), GLM-5.2 (744B MoE, MIT, 1M ctx), DeepSeek V4, Qwen3-Coder-Next, Hunyuan Hy3 (295B MoE, Apache 2.0).
- Best single-GPU models: Gemma 4 31B (Apache 2.0), Qwen3.8-27B (Apache 2.0, multimodal), gpt-oss-120b/20b (Apache 2.0).
- Longest context: Llama 4 Scout 10M tokens. Others at ~1M: DeepSeek V4, GLM-5.2, Qwen3.5. Kimi K2.6/K2.7 at 256-262K.
- Cleanest commercial licenses: Apache 2.0 (Qwen, Gemma 4, gpt-oss, Mistral, Wan, Hunyuan Hy3, Z-Image, BGE) and MIT (DeepSeek, GLM, Phi, Kokoro, CosyVoice, MiMo). Watch caps: Llama 4 (700M MAU), Moonshot K2.x serving (revenue-based), Qwen3.8-2.4T (custom), LTX (<$10M ARR), MiniMax (<$20M), FLUX.2 dev, Hunyuan video (100M MAU).
- Local install: ollama pull <model> (qwen3:8b, qwen3.8:27b, gemma4:e4b, gpt-oss:20b, phi4-mini, nomic-embed-text). VRAM ~ params x bits / 8; Q4_K_M is the local default.
- Best open embeddings: Qwen3-Embedding-8B (~70.6 MTEB), BGE-M3 (MIT). Best open image: Qwen-Image-2512. Best open video: Wan 2.2 / LTX-2.5. Best open TTS: Kokoro (CPU) and Qwen3-TTS. Best open realtime voice: Qwen2.5-Omni, GLM-4-Voice, Kimi-Audio. Best open 3D: TRELLIS.2 (MIT) and Hunyuan3D 2.x.

## Caveats
- Snapshot dated 2026-09-09; the model landscape changes monthly.
- Benchmarks are vendor-reported and not cross-harness comparable.
- "Open weights" is not "open source"; each model keeps its own license - read it (README section 20).
- Full disclaimer in README section 24.
